# Project Overview & General AI Guidelines (Auto-generated Draft)

Welcome to this C# .NET repository! In C#, classes are reference types and records are great for immutable data.
Always write clean code, follow SOLID principles, use meaningful variable names, and add comments where appropriate.
Make sure your code compiles before finishing.

## General Best Practices
- Use `async` and `await` for asynchronous programming in .NET.
- Follow standard Microsoft C# naming conventions (PascalCase for public members, camelCase for locals).
- Write unit tests for new features.
- Keep methods small and focused on a single responsibility.
